rawContent: I have spoken out a lot about my son who is in #lawenforcement. I can tell you He and I just had a conversation and I explain to him that I can support him and #police but also understand and support #peaceful #protest of #BlackLivesMatter

I wanted to end #racism I wanted to end hatred of #police before it became cool. We have to stop thinking that the following statements are exclusive or controversial #BlackLivesMatter #BlueLivesMatter #AllLivesMattter

I really beg @MSNBC and every other outlet to do this. I think it is great that you are carrying the memorial for #GeorgeFlyod live but also please the next time a cop is killed carry that too. We need to stop the sides mindset please #BlackLivesMatter #BlueLivesMatter @GLFOP

I consider myself smart but can anyone how defunding #police resolves the #racism that exists ? By not protecting the public you are somehow going to fix a few bad cops? I mean are we really living on fantasy Island at this point? #BlackLivesMatter #GeorgeFlyod #BlueLivesMatters
Does anyone know when we stop marching #BlackLivesMatter and we actually start talking to I don’t know actually try to resolve #racism ? Maybe we could start by not demonizing all of law-enforcement?
Please keep sharing this so we can #endthestigma #MentalHealthMatters #BlackLivesMatter #BlueLivesMatter #AllLivesMatters #UnitedNotDivided

I can’t sleep again so I’m watching #Obama to #Selma i think we forget in #BlackLivesMatter justified yes but don’t forget what’s been fought for and won. Look @BarackObama was President 8 years elected 2x that’s powerful celebrate it #progress

I have tried to support #BlackLivesMatter and support my son and his friends in #lawenforcement . Can someone help me understand how a police shooting in Atlanta caused the need for people to burn down the restaurant where the incident occurred?
